actions.name: scanned the company’s systems to determine if the systems were susceptible to a specific vulnerability
actions.description: On March 10, 2017, unidentified individuals scanned the company’s systems to determine if the systems were susceptible to a specific vulnerability that the United States Computer Emergency Readiness Team had publicly identified 2 days earlier.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Pinned catalogue component vuln-struts2-s2-045 provides the software this step acts on, so a step-specific check can be run against it; this does not mean the step was executed. The deployed release is assumed, not stated by the source.

actions.name: discovered a server housing Equifax’s online dispute portal running vulnerable software
actions.description: Unidentified individuals discovered a server housing Equifax’s online dispute portal that was running a version of the software that contained the vulnerability.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Pinned catalogue component vuln-struts2-s2-045 provides the software this step acts on, so a step-specific check can be run against it; this does not mean the step was executed. The deployed release is assumed, not stated by the source.

actions.name: gained unauthorized access to the Equifax portal and confirmed ability to run commands
actions.description: Using software designed to exploit the vulnerability, the unidentified individuals gained unauthorized access to the Equifax portal and confirmed that they could run commands. No data was taken at this time.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Pinned catalogue component vuln-struts2-s2-045 provides the software this step acts on, so a step-specific check can be run against it; this does not mean the step was executed. The deployed release is assumed, not stated by the source.

actions.name: gained access to the online dispute portal and used techniques to disguise activity
actions.description: Beginning on May 13, 2017, attackers gained access to the online dispute portal and used a number of techniques to disguise their activity, including leveraging existing encrypted communication channels to send queries and commands and retrieve PII.
actions.reproducibility_reason: The environment can be built (Apache Struts 2.3.30 showcase (CVE-2017-5638 / S2-045 exercise target)), but this step is not about that software and has no step-specific reproduction or validation; it remains untested.

actions.name: issued queries to other databases to search for sensitive data
actions.description: After gaining the ability to issue system-level commands on the online dispute portal, the attackers issued queries to other databases to search for sensitive data, including unencrypted usernames and passwords.
actions.reproducibility_reason: The target host has no deployable service, so it is left out of deployment; this step is not reproduced until a service or substitute is supplied for that host.

actions.name: leveraged credentials to expand access to additional databases
actions.description: The attackers leveraged unencrypted credentials to expand their access beyond the 3 databases associated with the online dispute portal to include an additional 48 unrelated databases.
actions.reproducibility_reason: The target host has no deployable service, so it is left out of deployment; this step is not reproduced until a service or substitute is supplied for that host.

actions.name: ran approximately 9,000 queries to extract PII from databases
actions.description: The attackers ran approximately 9,000 queries, a portion of which successfully returned data containing PII, while disguising their presence by blending in with regular network activity.
actions.reproducibility_reason: The target host has no deployable service, so it is left out of deployment; this step is not reproduced until a service or substitute is supplied for that host.

actions.name: removed extracted PII in small increments using encrypted web protocols
actions.description: After successfully extracting PII, the attackers removed the data in small increments, using standard encrypted web protocols to disguise the exchanges as normal network traffic.
actions.reproducibility_reason: The target host has no deployable service, so it is left out of deployment; this step is not reproduced until a service or substitute is supplied for that host.
